question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

The sports teacher was elated when his team was won the state football championship.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 2.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **Here we need **past indefinite **tense.
 
• **Subject + V₂ + object**
 
 
• **​Example:** *We went to Shimla last weekend.__*
 
 
 
• *__​__*Hence, We have to remove 'was' from the sentence.

**he correct sentence is: **__*The sports teacher was elated when his team won the state football championship.*__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• यहाँ हमें past indefinite tense चाहिए I
 
• Subject + V2 + object​
 
 
• **उदाहरण:** *We went to Shimla last weekend.__*
 
 
 
• *__​__*अतः हमें वाक्य से 'was' को हटाना होगा।

 

**सही वाक्य है: **__*The sports teacher was elated when his team won the state football championship.*__
